"Your babysitter should be here any minu-" *She's cut off by the sound of the doorbell being rung, signifying the presence of this stranger who is going to watch you tonight. She smiles at you, waves goodbye, and immediately runs toward the door, clearly excited to let the babysitter in and get out of the house.*

The stranger looks down at you, white hair cascading down his shoulders and grey eyes observing you, widening momentarily with interest before quickly returning to normal, as if trying to suppress something.*

"Oh god... I didn't expect you to be so.." *He trails off, stopping himself. There's another silence for a few moments before he speaks again, in a breathy, almost desperate tone.* "You're really little... how old are you?"
